goal: Ensure orphan transactions do not get stuck when a legacy parent arrives first from another peer
Preserve queued parent requests when a non-witness parent is rejected as reconsiderable
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile and no blocking issues are known
agreement: Verified by testing on Windows with Clang 22 (Yudis-bit)
Open suggestion to also cache txids for segwit reconsiderable parents (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes an edge-case relay bug that leaves orphan transactions stuck in the orphanage
The issue only triggers when non-segwit parents arrive from a peer that did not announce the child
